From: Samir Gupta <samir@nodecraftlabs.com>

Cc: priya.desai@nodecraftlabs.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NodeCraft production requests — service degradation on 9/14

Hi David,

Quick context: on 9/14 our production environment experienced repeated latency spikes between 02:20–03:10 PDT while using Redwood's v1 chat endpoint. Error rates rose and our front-end had to re-route traffic resulting in degraded UX for ~12k users. We collected logs and two stack traces, attached (service-incident-log-2025-09-14.txt).

We value Redwood's runtime but this incident materially impacted our demo day throughput and our internal billing. Can you advise on eligibility for a goodwill token top-up and a two-week trial extension while we finish onboarding? Our procurement lead is Priya Desai — copied.

What we need:
- Confirmation of incident window and remediation notes
- Proposed token credit amount or trial extension to offset customer impact
- Any evidence required from our side to fast-track approval

Thanks for the quick help.

—Samir
Head of Platform, NodeCraft Labs
From: david_kim@redwood.ai

Samir — thanks for the note and the logs. I'm really sorry this hit right before your demo day. I pulled the incident traces and I can confirm we saw elevated tail latency for a small subset of requests routed through us in us-west-2 between 02:18–03:12 PDT.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I've opened an internal ticket and looped in Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (sre/ops) to vet the scope.
- Please leave the attachment and any additional logs in the Drive link you shared; it'll speed validation.

For transparency, we'll try to provide:
1) A proposed token credit (initial estimate: 50k tokens) as a good-faith gesture pending confirmation, and
2) A complimentary two-week trial window extension for your staging/demo environment.

If it works for you, I'll escalate for formal approval and follow up with the finalized amount and the paperwork we need (SLA compensation request form).

—David
David Kim

Quick ops summary:
- Root-cause: transient upstream GPU host throttling during a maintenance event that concurrently affected a small pool of serving lanes. No data leakage.
- Impact window: 2025-09-14T02:18:00–2025-09-14T03:12:00 PDT.
- Retries observed: ~1.4x for affected requests, token burn estimated at +42k tokens above normal for that hour across NodeCraft's account.

Recommendation: approve a goodwill top-up of 45k tokens and offer a two-week staging extension. This balances cost and preserves the relationship — NodeCraft is an active mid-market account with expansion signals.

Karthik
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference
